stage: Evidence-Triggered Baseline Hold — Post-Fiscal-Closure Trigger Monitoring
purpose: Record the first trigger-monitoring snapshot after completion of the fiscal structural-primary provenance-only selective reopen. The pass searches only for evidence that matches existing declared reopen conditions and may not create a new model specification, infer missing values, inspect reserved outcomes, or reopen calibration because the queue is empty.

monitoring_scope.principle: Only genuinely new official evidence or an external event that satisfies a declared trigger can reopen a frozen boundary. Non-confirmation is not proof of permanent absence.
screened_classes: exact BNR BLS 2025-Q2 workbook or exact machine-readable equivalent
Eurostat/ECB/BNR accounting or sectoral-financial-position topology expansion

evidence.fact: The official BNR monetary-policy calendar surface remains the canonical event source. The existing frozen status records the next scheduled meeting after 2026-08-10 as 2026-10-08.

prospective_monetary_policy_event.trigger_test: Stage 1 opens only after an actually observed non-zero BNR policy-rate event in the reserved prospective window.
prospective_monetary_policy_event.conclusion: No new BNR policy meeting occurred between the 2026-09-19 check and this 2026-09-20 pass. The identification gate remains closed and reserved MIR response values remain uninspected.

evidence.source: BNR official Bank Lending Survey publication surface
evidence.fact: The official BNR BLS publication family remains available, but the targeted current-public search did not identify a reproducible exact 2025-Q2 workbook endpoint or exact machine-readable catalogue target.

aggregate_bank_credit_bls_2025_q2.boundary_rule: Do not guess BNR filenames, timestamps or internal endpoints and do not replace exact workbook cells with rounded report text.
aggregate_bank_credit_bls_2025_q2.conclusion: The declared source trigger remains unsatisfied. This is non-confirmation, not proof that the provider-side source does not exist.

evidence.fact: AMECO reports its last update as 2026-06-03 for the Spring 2026 Economic Forecast and states that AMECO is updated with each full Spring/Autumn forecast release.

fiscal_structural_primary_vintage_extens.conclusion: No new full AMECO release exists after the already retained Spring 2026 vintage. The 13-observation Spring first-historical UBLGBPS chain is therefore not lengthened by new evidence in this pass.

evidence.source: Romania Ministry of Finance Government Debt Management Strategy 2024-2026
evidence.fact: The published strategy provides marginal portfolio risk indicators such as debt due within one year, currency shares, average time to maturity and average time to refixing.

government_refinancing_effective_rate.boundary_rule: The frozen mechanism requires same-boundary opening principal, realised repriced/refinanced principal and matched old/new effective rates across material debt blocks.
government_refinancing_effective_rate.conclusion: The official risk indicators remain insufficient for point identification and do not create the required repricing ledger.

evidence.source: Eurostat Financial flows and stocks (nasq_10_f) reference metadata
evidence.fact: Current metadata states that mandatory who-to-whom quarterly tables cover deposits, short-term and long-term loans, with a second dataset for securities. It does not establish a complete mandatory F2-F8 counterpart matrix on the RMD boundary.

accounting_and_sectoral_financial_positi.conclusion: No changed public Eurostat topology satisfying the full quarterly non-consolidated S121 plus F2-F8 stock-and-transaction boundary was identified. No incomplete accounting instrument or sectoral-financial-position reference mode is reopened.
accounting_and_sectoral_financial_positi.caveat: This is a current-public-evidence monitoring result, not proof that no provider-side or future official source can exist.

next_monitoring_conditions: A non-zero BNR policy-rate decision followed by the contract-required official MIR response release.
An exact official BNR 2025-Q2 BLS workbook or exact machine-readable equivalent.
A new full AMECO vintage that materially changes the admissible real-time structural-primary history or a separately justified new fiscal identification design.
A changed official accounting/reference-mode dataset that satisfies the frozen sector, instrument, frequency, counterpart and transaction requirements.
